# Contributing to tablib

Thank you for your interest in contributing to tablib!

## Project layout

tablib uses the `src/` layout for its package. The actual source code for the
`tablib` package lives under `src/tablib/`, while the test suite lives in the
`tests/` directory at the repository root. Keep this in mind when adding new
modules or test files: application code belongs under `src/tablib/`, and
tests belong under `tests/`.

## Running the test suite

tablib's tests are written using [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/). To run
the test suite:

1. Install tablib in editable mode along with its development/test
   dependencies, for example:

   ```bash
   pip install -e .[all]
   pip install pytest
   ```

2. From the repository root, run:

   ```bash
   pytest
   ```

You can also run a specific test file or test case directly, e.g.:

```bash
pytest tests/test_tablib.py
pytest tests/test_tablib.py::SomeTestClass::test_something
```

Please make sure the test suite passes before submitting a pull request.
EOF
cat /tablib/CONTRIBUTING.md
```
